title: 네덜란드 Pivot 물량표 단가 입력·엑셀 계약

actions.name: DUTCH_PIVOT_LIVE_READ
actions.source: authenticated GET /api/stats/pivot-data with explicit orderYear + weekStart + weekEnd; extract Netherlands positive customer-product order quantities only

actions.name: DUTCH_PIVOT_WORKBOOK_UPLOAD
actions.source: optional client-side upload of the existing Pivot statistics workbook; extract positive customer-product quantity cells only

actions.name: DUTCH_PRICE_DRAFT
actions.source: browser localStorage keyed by uploaded filename; Enter focuses the next visible price input

actions.name: DUTCH_PRICE_WORKBOOK_EXPORT
actions.source: preserve source workbook and append or replace NL_단가표 with source cell, customer, product, color, quantity, currency, unit price, amount and completion state

criteriaLedger.authority: default source is authenticated read-only pivot-data with explicit year/week; uploaded workbook remains an optional alternate source
criteriaLedger.sheetDetection: sheet name or first three rows must contain 네덜란드, Netherlands, Holland or Dutch
criteriaLedger.header: the existing Pivot template uses row 3 for customer headers and 주문 marks the end of customer quantity columns
criteriaLedger.quantity: only finite numeric values greater than zero become price-entry rows
criteriaLedger.price: strictly positive value means complete; zero or blank remains pending
criteriaLedger.keyboard: Enter prevents form submission and focuses/selects the next visible price input
criteriaLedger.export: source workbook stays intact; NL_단가표 is replaced idempotently on re-export
criteriaLedger.currency: EUR default with explicit KRW choice

crossYearFixture.description: 직접 조회는 orderYear + weekStart + weekEnd를 모두 전달하고 단가 입력은 ERP에 쓰지 않으므로 전년도 동일 차수 Master를 섞거나 변경하지 않는다.

dnspyEvidence.source: FormQuantityPivot의 읽기 전용 업체·품목·수량 표시 결과를 엑셀 입력으로만 사용하며 ShipmentDetail.Cost 등 ERP 원장을 수정하지 않는다.
